name: Influenza (flu)
description: A respiratory illness that often starts suddenly and can cause marked fatigue.
care_notes: Rest and fluids are supportive measures.
The source discusses paracetamol or ibuprofen for discomfort; suitability must be checked.
Avoid combining products containing paracetamol. Antibiotics do not treat flu.
seek_help_notes: Seek urgent assessment for breathlessness, feeling very unwell, or failure to improve after seven days.
Sudden chest pain, severe breathing difficulty or coughing blood require emergency help.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; consult linked guidance for age-specific details. No doses or prescribing rules.

name: Sinusitis
description: Inflammation of the sinuses, often following a respiratory infection.
care_notes: Rest and fluids may help.
The source discusses pain relief and clinician-directed nasal steroids; antihistamines may help when allergy contributes.
Antibiotics are rarely needed.
seek_help_notes: Seek urgent assessment for severe illness, worsening symptoms, uncontrolled pain or a weakened immune system.
Persistent or recurring symptoms need professional assessment.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; consult linked guidance for age-specific details. No doses or prescribing rules.

name: COVID-19
description: An infection with symptoms that overlap with other respiratory illnesses; a symptom list alone cannot distinguish them.
care_notes: Rest and fluids may help.
The source discusses paracetamol or ibuprofen for discomfort; suitability must be checked.
People eligible for specific COVID-19 treatment should follow current professional testing and treatment advice.
seek_help_notes: Seek urgent assessment if symptoms worsen or fail to improve, especially in higher-risk people.
Sudden chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, coughing blood or collapse require emergency help.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; consult linked guidance for age-specific details. No doses or prescribing rules.

name: Headaches
description: Headaches have many causes, and symptoms alone do not establish which one applies.
care_notes: Drink water, keep regular meals and rest if you are also unwell. A headache diary can help identify patterns.
seek_help_notes: Seek medical assessment for headaches that persist, worsen or recur.
A sudden extremely painful headache, or headache with weakness, confusion, loss of vision or seizure needs emergency assessment.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not a diagnosis or medicine suitability check.

name: Sore throat
description: A sore throat is common and often improves by itself within about a week.
care_notes: Drink water, rest, avoid smoke and consider cool or soft foods. Ask a pharmacist before taking a medicine, especially during pregnancy.
seek_help_notes: Seek assessment if it does not improve after a week, frequently recurs or you have dehydration or a very high temperature.
Difficulty breathing, inability to swallow, drooling or rapidly worsening severe symptoms need emergency assessment.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not a prescription.

name: Hepatitis B
description: Hepatitis B is a liver infection spread through blood and body fluids. Many people have no symptoms or only mild symptoms; a test is needed to know whether it is present.
care_notes: If hepatitis B is suspected, ask a clinician about testing and vaccination. The source advises rest and hydration for people with the infection and discussing pain relief with a doctor.
seek_help_notes: See a clinician if you think you may have hepatitis B or are at higher risk. Treatment and follow-up depend on test results and whether infection persists.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; no diagnosis or treatment selection.

name: NSAIDs in pregnancy
description: Ibuprofen belongs to the NSAID medicine group. The FDA warns against NSAID use at around 20 weeks of pregnancy or later unless a healthcare professional specifically advises it.
care_notes: Ask a pharmacist or pregnancy clinician before using ibuprofen or another NSAID. Check the label because NSAIDs can also be ingredients in combination medicines.
seek_help_notes: A clinician must consider pregnancy stage and personal circumstances before advising on treatment. This app cannot determine personal medicine suitability.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: General safety information only; no personal medicine or dose recommendation.

name: Iron deficiency anaemia
description: Low iron can reduce red blood cell production. Blood tests and assessment of the cause are needed.
care_notes: Ask a clinician about testing and the cause. Dietary iron may help when intake is low.
seek_help_notes: Arrange assessment if you suspect anaemia; this summary does not select iron treatment.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Ear infection
description: Infections can affect different parts of the ear; examination helps distinguish the cause.
care_notes: Avoid putting fingers or cotton buds inside the ear and keep water out.
seek_help_notes: Seek assessment for persistent symptoms. New hearing loss, swelling, discharge or severe illness need urgent advice.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Appendicitis
description: Inflammation of the appendix needs urgent hospital assessment and treatment.
care_notes: Seek urgent assessment rather than relying on a symptom match.
seek_help_notes: Worsening or persistent abdominal pain, especially moving to the lower right, needs urgent assessment. Severe pain, confusion or breathing difficulty need emergency help.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Tonsillitis
description: Inflamed tonsils can cause a sore throat and swallowing difficulty.
care_notes: Rest and cool drinks may help; persistent or recurrent symptoms need assessment.
seek_help_notes: Seek urgent help if pain prevents drinking. Inability to swallow, breathing difficulty or rapidly worsening throat swelling needs emergency help.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Norovirus infection
description: A contagious infection that can cause sudden vomiting and diarrhoea.
care_notes: Rest, take frequent small sips and wash hands with soap and water.
seek_help_notes: Seek help for inability to retain fluids, dehydration, bloody diarrhoea, a child not feeding or persistent vomiting or diarrhoea.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Dehydration
description: The body has lost more fluid than it takes in.
care_notes: Take frequent small sips. A pharmacist can advise about oral rehydration solutions.
seek_help_notes: Persistent dizziness on standing, reduced urine or unusual drowsiness need urgent advice. Confusion, difficulty waking or breathing difficulty needs emergency help.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Chronic kidney disease
description: Kidney function gradually declines. Early disease often has no symptoms; blood and urine tests are needed.
care_notes: Ask a clinician about appropriate testing and follow-up. Symptoms alone cannot establish kidney disease.
seek_help_notes: Seek medical assessment for concerning symptoms or suspected kidney problems.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Dengue
description: A mosquito-borne viral infection that can range from a fever illness to severe bleeding and a fall in blood pressure.
care_notes: Seek clinical assessment for suspected dengue and follow local professional advice.
seek_help_notes: Bleeding or severe illness needs urgent assessment.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Typhoid
description: A bacterial infection associated with contaminated food and water.
care_notes: Seek a clinician’s assessment for suspected typhoid; treatment depends on professional evaluation.
seek_help_notes: Persistent or recurring fever needs medical assessment.
review_status: source_summarized; pending clinical and local applicability review
scope: Non-exhaustive educational summary; not an observed patient, diagnosis or prescription.

name: Tuberculosis
description: Active tuberculosis may cause prolonged respiratory and general symptoms; testing is necessary.
symptom_terms: cough for three or more weeks
care_notes: Seek testing and follow clinician-directed treatment; this summary does not supply a medicine regimen.
seek_help_notes: Prolonged cough needs prompt assessment. Coughing blood or breathing difficulty needs urgent help.
